name: Jesica Lozier
occupation: Lincoln County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Jesica Lozier is a Lincoln County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Kent Connelly, who is serving through the current term. SVI-NEWS reported that she finished second in the August 2026 Republican primary with 1,686 votes, ahead of Joe Heward at 1,678, and that she and Jake Long will join sitting commissioner Mel Shumway.
